products.name: Baby Spot Dad Cap
products.description: A lived-in, vintage-style cap that carries quiet personality. Made from soft 100% cotton twill with a low-profile, unstructured body, this distressed cap settles easily into daily rotation. The faded, roughened edges and subtle wear tell a story of long walks, backyard mornings, and dog-eared maps. A small, lifelike print of a black Labrador on the front adds a warm, loyal touch—an honest nod to pet people who prefer understated style over flash. The self-fabric hideaway strap with metal D-ring lets you fine-tune the fit, while the sewn-in label and six-panel construction keep the silhouette classic. Because each hat goes through a special finishing process, distress and color will vary slightly, giving every piece its own character.

Safe-tested across major regions and offered in multiple sizes, these tattoos bring that joyful, everyday moment with your dog wherever you go.

products.name: Engraved Bamboo Pizza Peel with Dog Silhouette Pattern — Personalized Serving & Cutting Board
products.description:
Light, warm, and a little playful — this engraved bamboo pizza board brings a quiet charm to weekend pizza nights. The smooth bamboo surface is laser-engraved with a repeated silhouette motif that darkens the wood and adds texture without overpowering the grain. Its paddle shape and short handle make transferring a fresh pie from oven to table effortless, and the single, all-purpose size fits most homemade and store-bought pizzas. Keep it close to the counter for rolling dough, slicing, or serving; it wears naturally into everyday kitchen life and ages with character.

This board feels at home in busy family kitchens and cozy small apartments alike. It pairs well with slow Sunday mornings, casual dinner parties, and evenings when everyone gathers around the table. The engraved pattern gives it personality — subtle, tasteful, and a little whimsical — so it feels like more than a tool: it’s part of the ritual of sharing food and conversation.

Care note: to preserve the engraving and natural finish, hand wash gently and dry immediately. With simple upkeep the bamboo will remain sturdy and beautiful for years of happy meals.

products.name: Engraved Whiskey Glass 10.5oz — Minimal Dots Pattern, Personalized Bar Gift
products.description:
This engraved 10.5 oz whiskey glass brings quiet, thoughtful style to evening rituals. The clear, heavy-bottom tumbler feels substantial in the hand and showcases a subtle pattern of etched marks that catch light without shouting for attention. It’s at home on a low-slung bar cart, beside a leather-bound book, or on the coffee table during a slow, conversation-filled night. Use it for neat pours, small cocktails, or a cooling glass of juice — the design reads as refined and approachable, fading into the background while elevating the moment.

Built to handle everyday use, the glass stands up to the dishwasher and regular wear, so those evenings of poured-off worries and shared stories can repeat without fuss. For people who favor calm, considered objects, this tumbler becomes part of the ritual: a stable, honest piece that complements a home made for lingering.
